description: The same engine with every `rule=` target naming a declared variant. Isolates target-membership from the `rule=` attribute.
rationale: §51.0.F — `rule=` declares the set of variants a state-child may transition TO. A target absent from the `for=` enum names no reachable state, so the rule is a contract that can never be satisfied; rejecting it at compile time is what keeps `rule=` a checkable contract rather than documentation.
